"""Check rounds/core partition invariant over many random peeling cases."""
import random, sys, importlib.util
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import ref
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
rng = random.Random(99)
bad = 0
for t in range(3000):
    pool = rng.sample(range(1, 60), rng.randint(2, 12))
    ixps = set(rng.sample(pool, rng.randint(0, 2)))
    paths = []
    for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 10)):
        k = rng.randint(2, 12)
        p = []
        while len(p) < k:
            x = rng.choice(pool)
            if not p or p[-1] != x:
                p.append(x)
        paths.append(tuple(p))
    agg = {}
    for p in paths:
        q = ref.normalize(list(p), ixps)
        if len(q) < 2 or len(set(q)) != len(q): continue
        agg[tuple(q)] = agg.get(tuple(q), 0) + 1
    la, ra, fa = ref.peel_naive(agg)
    lb, rb, fb = m._peel(list(agg.items()))
    coreb = {m._canon(p[i],p[i+1]) for p,_c in fb for i in range(len(p)-1)}
    # invariant: all_links == rounds.keys() | core
    if not (set(rb.keys()) | coreb) == lb or (set(rb.keys()) & coreb):
        bad += 1; print('INVARIANT FAIL', sorted(lb), sorted(rb), sorted(coreb)); break
    if ra != rb or la != lb:
        bad += 1; print('MISMATCH'); break
print('invariant failures:', bad)
